integrity: The underlying Hermite matrix formula is explicitly credited to prior work; the new statements are precise optimizations and asymptotics of that matrix. Finite check results do not replace proofs.
scientific_limitations: Fixed second polyanalytic order, horizontal Gaussian strip and asymptotic half-widths. No finite-width uniqueness theorem for the positive maximizing fiber; no actual direct-integral norm-attaining vector asserted. Historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp off-center optimization for order-two polyanalytic strip localization
